checks.detail: nQON observation, per-site Rise/Fall/Hys logging, and invalid-capture handling are present. ExpectValue is REFERENCE_ONLY and numericPassFail is NOT_SPECIFIED; no numeric limit or tolerance was created.

checks.detail: Both normal and fault paths drive VAC2 and VBAT to zero before relay release, leave no active SetOn relays, and retain DFT finish[] after the safe zero/off state. BST/SW differential is explicitly not applicable with endpoint proof.
